text:
adele: Pager - large increase in 502s for /v1/encoder on prod-canary after the deploy. Canary instances are crashlooping and HPA dropped to 0 pods during node cordon. Customer impact: some inference requests falling back or timing out.
oncall-bot: [ALERT] svc/inference-encoder high 5xx rate (prod-canary) — paging oncall-miguel
miguel: ack - I'm on it, taking pager. Can someone post the last deploy id?
adele: deploy id 2026-03-17-encoder-v2, nodecordon happened as part of maintenance (infra). Logs show liveness failures: /healthz returning 503 briefly.
jin: looking at the manifest from the rollout — liveness probe path changed to /healthz but service only exposes /ready for the new container. That mismatch will cause restarts.
leo: confirmed - image starts slower, readiness initialDelaySeconds is 5 (too low). Combined with liveness hitting wrong endpoint -> crashloop.
miguel: ok mitigation plan: 1) flip feature flag to route traffic off canary 2) scale stable replicaset up 3) rollback canary / undo rollout 4) patch HPA/minReplicas if needed.
product-ops: product agrees to flip flag - we need customer-ops heads-up.
customer-success: notifying affected customers now, will include advisory that we are rolling back the canary and enabling fallback.
jin: commands I suggest:
```
kubectl get pods -n inference -l app=encoder -o wide
kubectl scale deployment/encoder-stable --replicas=4 -n inference
kubectl rollout undo deployment/encoder-service --to-revision=3 -n inference
# quick patch to HPA min replicas
kubectl patch hpa encoder-service -n inference --type='merge' -p '{"spec":{"minReplicas":2}}'
```
adele: I'll flip the feature flag now: toggling `dynamic-encoder-v2` -> OFF :spinner:
adele: feature flag off confirmed. Traffic should be routed to stable.
miguel: scaling stable now
leo: stable pods are coming up, readiness green on 3/4
jin: rolling back the canary to previous rs now, sending rollout undo
miguel: rollback initiated. Monitoring tail logs... crashloops stop on canary after traffic drains.
adele: HPA patched to minReplicas=2. Will follow up with permanent fix: restore liveness path and increase initialDelaySeconds in manifest, and add integration test for probe/path mismatch.
sre-rotations: infra note: nodecordon overlapped with the canary window, we'll add guard to avoid cordoning nodes that are serving canaries during deploys.
customer-success: customers updated: incident mitigated, we're running postmortem and will follow up in 24h.
adele: recording incident. Will open postmortem and link to diff/PR for probe fix. Thanks all :thumbsup:
